summary: Backend smoke test for Prometheus platform. 27 checks passed, 1 real backend bug (POST /workflows returns 500). Two initial 'failures' were test-script parsing bugs (nested is_admin path, SSE data-only frames) and were manually re-verified as PASSING against raw server response.
passed: GET /api/auth/me admin -> user.is_admin=true, subscription.tier=enterprise (nested under user/subscription)
POST /api/billing/checkout for pro_monthly, pro_annual, enterprise_monthly, enterprise_annual -> all 200 with valid https://checkout.stripe.com URL
SSE GET /api/runs/{id}/stream: text/event-stream content-type, emits snapshot, agent_status, agent_token deltas, and terminal run_status events (all observed in raw stream)
Run reaches status=completed within ~15s with 3 agent_outputs: Analyzer, Classifier, Synthesizer

failed.issue: POST /api/workflows returns 500 Internal Server Error when creating a workflow with body {name, agents:[{type:'Analyzer',provider:'gemini'}]} as admin/enterprise user
failed.evidence: Backend log: TypeError: vars() argument must have __dict__ attribute at fastapi/encoders.py line 327 (jsonable_encoder). Response body: 'Internal Server Error'. Cause: server.py:646 `return wf` where wf['agents'] contains Pydantic AgentSpec models that fail jsonable_encoder; possibly also body.agents[i].get('type') at line 635 called on Pydantic model instead of dict.

action_items: Fix POST /api/workflows in /app/backend/server.py create_workflow(): (1) convert AgentSpec Pydantic objects to dicts before iterating with .get() and before storing/returning (use [a.model_dump() for a in body.agents] or a.type attribute access), (2) ensure returned wf dict is JSON-serializable.

test_script_false_negatives_reverified: GET /api/auth/me: is_admin/tier are nested under 'user' and 'subscription' keys — verified is_admin=true, tier=enterprise

SSE stream: server emits SSE frames as `data: {"event": "..."}` JSON payloads (no `event:` line prefix). All required event types (snapshot, agent_status, agent_token, run_status) present in raw capture.
